    Balls and connected sets in a ray category #

    Two objects are adjacent when there is a nonzero morphism between them (Adj). Balls for this relation are finite (ball_finite). A finite set S is connected when every set closed under adjacency into S contains all of S or none of it (IsConnSet). A connected set with n elements through a lies in the ball of radius n around a (subset_ball), so there are finitely many such sets (finite_connSets).
